page.overview:
Who is Mrs. Evans?

Mrs Evans (d. between late 1977 and 31 October 1981) was a Muggle woman and the mother of Petunia and Lily Evans. Through Petunia, she was the maternal grandmother of Dudley Dursley, and through Lily, the maternal grandmother of Harry Potter and paternal great-grandmother of James Sirius, Albus Severus and Lily Luna Potter.

Mrs Evans and her husband lived in Cokeworth, England. The couple had two daughters: Petunia, born in the late 1950s, and Lily, born 30 January 1960.

While Petunia was a Muggle like her parents, Lily turned out to be a Muggle-born witch, something that made Mrs and Mr Evans proud. Petunia, on the other hand, was jealous, considering her sister a "freak." According to Petunia, Mrs and Mr Evans favoured Lily, talking about her constantly.

On 1 September 1971, Mrs Evans and her husband took Lily and Petunia to Platform Nine and Three-Quarters, to see Lily off to her first year at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry.
